question: A thin, rigid, non-conducting rod of length $2L$ has two small particles of mass $m$ and charges $+q$ and $-q$ fixed at its ends. The rod is placed in a uniform electric field $E$ and is free to rotate about its center. It is slightly displaced from its stable equilibrium position. Analyze the restoring torque and the system's moment of inertia to determine the angular frequency $ω$ of the resulting small oscillations. (Ignore the mass of the rod itself).
